name: Torrents
tip: Tap a torrent to open it, or a folder to go in. Organize with folders.

children.name: dash
children.tip: What this device holds and gives: folders you publish, pinned copies you seed, the library on disk, and how often others have downloaded from you.

children.name: flt_all
children.label: All
children.tip: Show every torrent.

children.name: flt_mine
children.label: Mine
children.tip: Show only the torrents you created.

children.name: lib_newfolder
children.label: New folder
children.tip: Create a subfolder here to organize torrents.

children.name: torrents
children.empty:
Nothing here yet.
Tap + to share a folder, or search the network for something to download.
children.tip: Tap a torrent to open it, or a folder to go in.

name: Add
tip: Open a link, or share a folder.

children.name: t_open_link
children.label: Open a link
children.tip: Paste an ntorrent1... link to download it.

children.name: t_scan_qr
children.label: Scan a QR code
children.tip: Point the camera at a torrent's QR code to open it (Android).

children.name: t_add_disk
children.label: Share a folder
children.tip: Turn a folder on this device into a torrent.

name: Search
tip: Search the whole network - every listing published to the mesh - by title, description or tags, or browse by category.

children.name: srch_sort
children.label: Sort
children.tip: Cycle sort: seeders, recently updated, size (shown in the results header).

children.name: srch_cats
children.label: Categories
children.tip: Browse torrents by category (only categories that have torrents are shown).

children.name: results
children.empty:
Type above to search the network, or tap Categories to browse.
Results marked 'on the network' come from other devices - open one to fetch its listing.
children.tip: Tap a category to browse it, or a torrent to open its listing.
More

children.name: listing_browse
children.label: Browse files
children.tip: Open the full-screen file browser.

children.name: listing_opendir
children.label: Open folder on disk
children.tip: Show this torrent's real files in the system file manager (yours, or a pinned copy).

children.name: listing_move
children.label: Move to folder
children.tip: File this torrent under one of your organizing folders.

children.name: listing_edit
children.label: Edit listing
children.tip: Describe what you share (publisher only).

children.name: listing_popularity
children.label: Popularity
children.tip: See how many peers seed and download this over the months (kept on your device).

children.name: listing_updates
children.label: Get updates
children.tip: Follow the publisher's changes, or freeze a static copy to save bandwidth.

children.name: t_manage
children.label: Manage
children.tip: Pin, rescan, copy link or remove this torrent.

children.name: listing_media
children.tip: The listing, then a simple file browser. Tap a screenshot to open it full-screen; tap a file to open it, or use the ☰ menu to browse full-screen.

children.name: pop_chart
children.tip: How many peers hold (seeders) and download (leechers) this torrent each month. Counted on your device only, never stored in the folder.

children.name: m_title
children.label: Title
children.tip: Up to 50 characters.

children.name: m_desc
children.label: Description
children.tip: Up to 200 characters.

children.name: m_cat
children.label: Category
children.tip: Pick one. Use the +18 switch for adult, not a category.

children.name: m_tags
children.label: Tags
children.tip: Up to 10, comma separated.

children.name: m_adult
children.label: +18 (adult)
children.tip: Adult content flag.

children.name: m_save
children.label: Save the listing
children.tip: Publish the listing.

children.name: m_icon
children.label: Icon
children.tip: A small square icon for this torrent — like a website's tab icon. Shown next to it in the list. Saved as data/favicon.*

children.name: m_cover
children.label: Cover image
children.tip: Poster / box art. Up to 30MB.

children.name: m_banner
children.label: Banner image
children.tip: A wide header image. Up to 30MB.

children.name: m_trailer
children.label: Trailer (webm)
children.tip: A short clip. Up to 30MB.

children.name: m_gallery
children.label: Add a screenshot / clip
children.tip: Images or short clips, up to 10, each 30MB max.

children.name: swarm_refresh
children.label: Refresh
children.tip: Ask the Indexers again who is holding this folder.

children.name: swarm_log
children.label: Holders
children.tip: Best holder first: an awake machine on mains and a real uplink beats a phone on battery and a metered data plan. "direct" = we heard this device ourselves; "dht" = an Indexer told us.

children.name: copy_link
children.label: Copy link
children.tip: Show and copy the ntorrent1... link. It carries the folder key, a few provider hints and the publisher - the name is deliberately NOT in it, because an unsigned name in a link is a phishing surface.

children.name: copy_id
children.label: Copy id (hex)
children.tip: Copy the raw hex folder id.

children.name: info_log
children.label: Torrent info
children.tip: Link, file count, size, and how often this device has served its files.

children.name: downloads
children.tip: Where downloaded torrents are stored on disk.

children.name: dl_root
children.label: Download folder
children.tip: Downloaded torrents are written here as real files, and the subfolders under it organize your list. Point it at a folder from a previous install to re-adopt everything inside.

children.name: dl_folder
children.label: Change download folder
children.tip: Pick the folder where downloads are stored.

children.name: seeding
children.tip: Pin to keep a full copy and seed it.

children.name: pin_on_open
children.label: Pin what I download
children.tip: After opening a link, keep a full copy and seed it. Turn this off to download without joining the swarm - it works, but a network of pure leechers holds nothing.

children.name: share_author
children.label: Put my identity in shared links
children.tip: OFF by default. When on, links you copy include your npub so people know who published it. Leave it off to share anonymously - the folder key alone is enough to download.

children.name: rescan_min
children.label: Rescan my folders every (minutes)
children.tip: How often a torrent shared from disk is re-scanned, so files you add or delete on disk are published to the swarm. 0 = never (rescan by hand from Manage).

children.name: settings_apply
children.label: Apply
children.tip: Save these settings.

children.name: settings_log
children.label: This device
children.tip: What this device is currently holding and serving.
